mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 69 degrees at Verona Community Park, with an air quality index of 51. We are in the third quarter moon phase, and you can spot the space station tomorrow morning at 5:13 AM as it travels from the west over Mount Horeb toward the south over Belleville. Expect an overnight low of 62 degrees with no rain.

Verona police arrested a Madison teacher for sexual assault of a child following a report from the school district about an incident that occurred in 2019. Also, road work on Highway M continues with traffic shifts beginning the week of September 7, and the Military Ridge State Trail will see closures from mid-September to mid-November for bridge work.

There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market today, along with live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can find yoga on September 7, trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee on September 8, and the Downtown Farmers Market on September 9.
The Verona Police Department confirmed that a 34-year-old woman was arrested on September 4 following an investigation into an incident that occurred on Sunday, August 30.
Enjoy the Mint Cookie flavor of the day while you can, as the store is currently open but will be closing soon in 23 minutes.
